EmptyElement.description: EmptyElement represents a presence-only XML flag such as <unique/> or <hoarder/>.

NamedRef.description: NamedRef stores the name attribute used by CE reference elements such as usage, category, tag, value, type, and group.

name.description: Name is the identifier referenced by the containing CE element.

SpawnableAttachment.description: SpawnableAttachment defines one attachment-generation rule for an item.

chance.description: Chance is the probability, from 0 to 1, that this attachment rule is selected.

item.description: Items are attachment candidates listed directly instead of in a named preset.

preset.description:
Preset names an attachment preset from cfgrandompresets.xml.
When set, the preset provides the candidate items for this attachment rule.

SpawnableCargo.description: SpawnableCargo defines one cargo-generation rule for an item.

chance.description: Chance is the probability, from 0 to 1, that this cargo rule is selected.

item.description: Items are item candidates listed directly instead of in a named preset.

preset.description:
Preset names a cargo preset from cfgrandompresets.xml.
When set, the preset provides the candidate items for this cargo rule.

SpawnableItem.description: SpawnableItem is one item candidate in cargo, attachment, or random-preset rules.

attachments.description: Attachments defines items that may be attached to this item.

cargo.description: Cargo defines items that may be generated inside this item.

chance.description:
Chance is a probability from 0 to 1, or a percentage weight when the
explicit chance values in its parent group use the 0 to 100 scale.

damage.description: Damage sets the health range for this item when it is spawned.

name.description: Name is the game class name of the candidate item.

SpawnableMinMax.description: SpawnableMinMax stores a lower and upper bound used to randomize a numeric property when an item is created.

max.description: Max is the inclusive upper bound for the generated property.

min.description: Min is the inclusive lower bound for the generated property.

SpawnableTypeDef.description: SpawnableTypeDef defines randomized cargo and attachment contents for one item class.

attachments.description:
Attachments defines the items or named preset that can be attached to this item.
Defining attachments in an override replaces the original attachment rules for this type.

cargo.description:
Cargo defines the items or named preset that can be generated inside this item's cargo.
Defining cargo in an override replaces the original cargo rules for this type.

damage.description:
Damage sets the minimum and maximum health for the spawned item.
In an override file, this setting affects only new or redefined types.

hoarder.description: Hoarder marks this class for hoarder-related spawn handling.

name.description: Name is the game class whose cargo and attachment spawn rules are defined.

tag.description: Tags attach named filters used to select compatible spawn presets.

unique.description: Unique marks this type's spawn rules as unique. In an override file, this flag replaces the original type's flag set.

SpawnableTypesFile.description: SpawnableTypesFile defines which cargo items and attachments may be created when CE spawns an item, vehicle, or other configured class.

spawnabletypes.description: XMLName identifies the required `<spawnabletypes>` document root.

type.description: Types map game classes to their cargo and attachment generation rules.
